design-system.text: Expedition Journal token set is authoritative in design.yaml (project root). Semantic status tokens: info/warning/success/danger, plus primary terracotta reserved for the one primary action per screen. Rules: no purple/indigo anywhere, no gradients in UI chrome, flat score fills only (#16a34a/#d97706/#dc2626/#1E5F8C), emoji never as icons (use client/app/components/ui/icons.tsx), scores pair number+label with color. Dark mode contrast note: warm gray-500 is AA on parchment but fails on dark charcoal, so dark section-title stays gray-400.
